Resistances (info)

Conditions

  • Alarmed Debtor

    • This creature has spotted you as an intruder.

Features

  • Darkvision

    Can see in the dark up to a certain distance.

  • Forever Indebted

    Upon dying, explodes in a fireball and is then reincarnated into a fiendish creature bound to Raphael.

  • Opportunity Attack

    Attack an enemy moving out of reach.

Eternal Debtors are one of many humanoid[1] enemies located in the House of Hope.

Involvement

Act Three

Eternal Debtors wander through the corridors of the House of Hope and raise the alarm if they spot any intruders. They remain passive if party members are disguised with  Debtor's Attires which can be acquired from  Hope or found within various wardrobes around the building.

Combat

On their first turn in combat, they attempt to rush an enemy and use  Forever Indebted, dealing Fireball style damage and killing themselves in the process. Afterwards, they permanently turn into a Vengeful Boar, Vengeful Imp, or Vengeful Merregon.

Notes and references

  1. ↑ There is also one non-humanoid Eternal Debtor: the  Eternal Rat. It can be spoken to without  Speak with Animals active. In addition to a basic attack, it can also  Bite its opponent.
  2. ↑ There are four Librarian Eternal Debtors in the archive of the House of Hope. Unlike all other Raphael's indebted servants, they can also cast  Bone Chill in combat.
